Package com.j3d.engine.react.history

Class History

java.lang.Object
java.util.AbstractCollection<Action<?>>
java.util.AbstractList<Action<?>>
java.util.ArrayList<Action<?>>
com.j3d.engine.react.history.History
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable, Iterable<Action<?>>, Collection<Action<?>>, List<Action<?>>, RandomAccess, SequencedCollection<Action<?>>
public class History extends ArrayList<Action<?>>
Manages a history of actions, allowing for undo and redo functionality. It extends ArrayList to store Action objects.
Author:
Lehlogonolo Poole
